claims.claim: Gearbox for Ford Econoline E150 E250 E350 V8
claims.evidence: Photos show an engine and transmission assembly but no visible badging, VIN, or part numbers confirming Ford Econoline fitment.
Origin cannot be determined from the photos; would require documentation or visible origin markings not present.
Provenance is not shown in the photos; import documents or history would be needed.
Photos show a dusty used assembly but do not establish a standard of working condition.

risks.risk: Engine does not run or turn over
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking or running

risks.risk: Transmission does not shift or engage gears
risks.proof: Video of gear selection and engagement
Odometer photo or import/service records showing mileage
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown or high mileage

risks.risk: Internal engine wear or low compression
risks.proof: Compression test results or borescope video
Close-up video of engine underside and seals after warm-up

risks.risk: Incorrect fitment for Ford Econoline V8
risks.proof: Clear photo of VIN, engine code, or part number

proof_requests: Clear close-up of any VIN, engine code, or part number plate
Video of engine cranking or running and transmission shifting through gears
Odometer or import documents for mileage and provenance
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a used engine and transmission assembly, so a worst-case price can be set despite unverified origin, fitment, and condition claims.
